items.text: The Lions placed linebacker Jack Campbell on injured reserve, the team announced Saturday.

items.title: Vikings rule Jauan Jennings out for Monday night
items.text: Wide receiver Jauan Jennings passed on a possible trade back to the 49ers in order to remain with the Vikings, but he won't be in Minnesota's lineup against the Bills on Monday night.

items.title: Vikings WR Jauan Jennings declined 49ers interest because "I love where I'm at"
items.text: Wide receiver Jauan Jennings has not played a major role in the Vikings offense through the first eight weeks of the season, but he wasn't interested in switching teams when the possibility presented itself last month.

items.title: Bills list Dion Dawkins as questionable to play on Monday night
items.text: Dion Dawkins didn't practice at all this week, but the Bills aren't counting him out for Monday night's game against the Vikings.

items.title: Cowboys place OLB Malachi Lawrence on IR, activate OLB Marist Liufau from IR
items.text: The Cowboys placed outside linebacker Malachi Lawrence on injured reserve, the team announced Saturday.

items.title: Philip Rivers completes high-school season, confirms interview with NC State
items.text: It's looking more and more like former NFL and NC State quarterback Philip Rivers will be the next coach of the Wolfpack.

items.title: Report: Broncos are seeking a tight end trade, Cardinals rebuffed request for Trey McBride
items.text: Denver would like to acquire a veteran tight end before Tuesday's trade deadline, but that tight end will apparently not be Arizona's Trey McBride.

items.title: Commanders activate DT Johnny Newton from injured reserve
items.text: The Commanders are activating defensive tackle Johnny Newton from injured reserve, Ian Rapoport of NFL Media reports.

items.title: Joe Burrow can become third quarterback with four or more TD passes in four straight games
items.text: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow had seven touchdown passes in his team's first four games of the season.

items.title: Saints release RB Kendre Miller
items.text: The Saints, on the last day before their first game since Week 7, have made a change.

items.title: Rams activate Myles Garrett, put Jaylen Watson on IR

items.title: Deshaun Watson clears concussion protocol, remains questionable for Sunday
items.text: Shedeur Sanders will start against the Saints.

items.title: Quentin Lake apologized to Justin Herbert for "deli meat" and "seeing ghosts" comments
items.text: Rams safety Quentin Lake got plenty of attention for comments he made about intercepting a pass thrown by Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert, but on reflection, Lake didn't like the attention he generated.

items.title: Ravens reportedly tell Derrick Henry they have "no intention" of trading him
items.text: Ravens running back Derrick Henry's production has plummeted since quarterback Lamar Jackson was first injured before halftime in a Week 4 win over the Titans.

items.title: Report: Colts are in trade talks regarding QB Daniel Jones
items.text: The list of "multiple teams" currently includes the Ravens (who pivoted elsewhere) and the Vikings.

items.text: Garrett and Donald will play together for the first time on Sunday against the Commanders.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes is closing in on the record for most TD passes in a QB's first 10 years
items.text: Mahomes has 325 career touchdown passes, counting the playoffs. Peyton Manning had 327 in his first 10 seasons.
